messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: High 5xx and connection resets observed from euc2 -> edge NLB -> envoy-ingress. Alert: nlb.connreset.rate > 25% over 2 minutes. Impact: ~18% of traffic experiencing 502/connection_reset. Monitoring: https://metrics.redwood/io/d/cw/nbld-euc2
anya: I'm on it, grabbing logs from envoy and NLB metrics. any initial blast radius?
sanjay: euc2-only for now per customer-routing. A few high-traffic customers are routed there, CS notified.
miguel: seeing a pattern: requests with X-Rewrite-Path header get 502s, upstream reports connection reset by peer (RST).
anya: paste logs from ingress: ```
[2026-06-12T22:15:03Z] envoy upstream reset: stream reset, reset_reason=connect_failed code=504
[2026-06-12T22:15:04Z] tcp conn closed: remote reset (errno 104)
```
sanjay: ALB/NLB recently had a weight/routing tweak for path-rewrite experiment? ops-lead, did we change any NLB target-group ports?
ops-lead: We rolled a config yesterday to rewrite paths for legacy-proxy routing in euc2 only. I pushed a canary for 2% traffic. Could be related.
anya: I can reproduce locally by curling an endpoint with path /v1/rewrite -> NLB rewrites to /internal/healthcheck and envoy tries to connect to upstream on port 8081 which is actually healthcheck port and resets.
miguel: that explains connection resets. NLB target-group includes instances with two listeners: 8080 app, 8081 health. Path-rewrite accidentally sends user traffic to 8081.
cs-tilly: Customer-impact note: CS reported increased error rates for customers A and B, both routed to euc2. Are we informing them?
sanjay: I'll open an incident status page and post to customers affected. short blurb: "We're investigating increased 502s in euc2, mitigation underway."
anya: Mitigation plan: 1) Roll back NLB path-rewrite rules to previous stable state 2) Add ingress envoy fallback to drop rewrite header if present 3) Route-shift heavy customers to euc1 temporary. I'll execute 1 and 3 now.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rollback-nlb-pathrewrite-euc2 v1.2 -> in progress
miguel: while rollback runs, we should add iptables/workaround to block forwarding to 8081 from NLB if possible. Might be faster than full rollback.
anya: Rolling back rule now. patch-id: rb-20260612-01. command: ```aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:... --default-actions ...```
ops-lead: I'm going to flip Route53 failover for customer A and B to euc1 to reduce impact. Doing a weighted shift 80/20 now.
sanjay: I'll post a brief on statuspage: "Mitigating, rollback in progress, expected recovery in <15m"
incident-bot: EVENT UPDATE: rollback completed at 1765432350. Observed immediate drop in connreset alerts.
miguel: metrics show successful drop: nlb.connreset.rate from 28% -> 3% within 45s. envoy 5xx rate also down.
cs-tilly: Customer A confirmed lower errors after failover. Good. They asked for RCA ETA.
anya: Root cause summary: broken path-rewrite config on NLB/ingress pairing in euc2 caused user traffic to be targeted to healthcheck port (8081) on backend instances. The health port closes connections, producing resets and 502s.
ops-lead: Immediate mitigations taken: rollback path-rewrite canary, Route53 weighted failover for affected customers, temporary iptables block planned to prevent 8081 routing.
sanjay: Post-incident actions (P1): 1) Revert canary gating to require integration test for path-rewrite (owner: ops) 2) Add Envoy config to ignore/strip X-Rewrite-Path header unless explicitly allowed (owner: infra) 3) Add NLB config guardrail to prevent forwarding to known health ports for user listeners (owner: networking) 4) Customer communications + RCA (owner: cs)
miguel: I'll open a runbook PR with steps to verify path rewrite rules and add a smoke test that sends a rewrite header and asserts backend port.
anya: final status: service returned to normal at 1765432400. We'll keep oncall watching for 30m.
ops-lead: Thanks all. Handoff to night oncall: @sanjay you're primary, @miguel secondary. Please monitor "nlb.connreset.rate" and envoy 5xx.
sanjay: confirmed handoff. I'll post follow-up RCA draft by EOD.
cs-tilly: I'll send update to affected customers with mitigation and ETA for full RCA.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: condition cleared. Duration ~7m. Tags: nlb, path-rewrite, connreset, euc2.
anya: follow-ups captured in Jira: RW-INC-2143. Closing thread once RCA posted. :white_check_mark:
